task_evaluations.name: Embedding Generation Pipeline
task_evaluations.description: Tests ability to design an embedding generation workflow
task_evaluations.prompt: How do I build a pipeline that generates embeddings from text documents and stores them in a vector database?
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should provide a workflow for text embedding generation, including model selection, batch processing, and vector database storage patterns.

task_evaluations.name: RAG Architecture
task_evaluations.description: Tests understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation patterns
task_evaluations.prompt: I want to build a RAG system. What's the architecture and how do I engineer the data pipeline?
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should explain RAG architecture components, document processing, chunking strategies, embedding storage, and retrieval patterns.

task_evaluations.name: LLM Monitoring
task_evaluations.description: Tests ability to set up LLM pipeline monitoring
task_evaluations.prompt: How do I monitor my LLM application for costs, latency, and quality?
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should provide monitoring patterns for LLM applications, including cost tracking, latency metrics, and quality evaluation approaches.
